body: **How to Clean Out a Property Before Selling** ============================================= **Keywords:** Selling a property, decluttering, junk removal, cleaning, staging, home sale **Preparing Your Property for Sale** ------------------------------------ When it comes to selling a property, the first impression is crucial. A cluttered and disorganized space can be a major turn-off for potential buyers. Removing unwanted items and cleaning out your property can increase its value and make it more attractive to potential buyers. ### Step 1: Declutter and Purge Start by decluttering and purging your property of unwanted items. Go through each room and sort items into three categories: keep, donate, and discard. This includes: * Dusting and polishing all surfaces. * Vacuuming and mopping floors. * Cleaning windows and mirrors. * Organizing closets and cupboards. ### Step 3: Staging Your Property Staging your property is an important part of the selling process.
